was in focus on Wednesday as Evercore upped its price target on the IT to $650 from $575 and kept it as a top pick, despite the recent surge in shares.
Dell shares fell 0.7% in premarket trading.

“Despite the recent appreciation in DELL shares, we see room for further upside as DELL is positioned to benefit from – a) emergence & acceleration of neocloud deployments; b) Enterprise AI adoption that is just starting and will provide durability of growth AND margin expansion; c) sustained supply chain challenges will enable DELL to accelerate share gains + margins; and d) strong and disciplined capital allocation,” analyst Amit Daryanani wrote in a note to clients. “While investors are focused on pre-buying/memory increases, what is underappreciated is we are at the cusp of the de-commoditization of the IT Hardware stack that DELL will benefit from disproportionately enabling not just rev/EPS growth but also multiple expansion. We see upside to current FY27 Street EPS of ~$25.88, with our BULL case surpassing $30+, while a combination of higher AI attach, continued AI server growth (FY27 upside at $85B and FY28 upside at $125B), storage margin expansion (to >30% EBIT margins), opex leverage and incremental capital returns creates a path for FY28 EPS getting to >$40 vs. street at ~$31. We see room for further upside and a path to $1,000 (P/E 25x, $40 of EPS).”

title: Dell Technologies in focus as Evercore ups price target, maintains it as top pick
